person: Beverly Shaw is a 72-year-old retired fourth-grade teacher in Roanoke, Virginia. She is using an AI tool for the first time and is wary of scams, partly because $800 left her checking account last spring through the payment app. In August her grandson Tyler helped her send a data-broker deletion request, and she still finds her name and old address on people-search sites. She wants to be told what will happen before it happens and what she can stop. She reads every screen twice and is easily rattled by words she doesn't know. She is not sure the whole thing is safe, so she will not hand over a password or full account number unless she understands why.
stated_up_front: Hello, I'm sorry, I'm not very good with these things. My grandson Tyler said you could help me get my name taken off those websites that list people's addresses, and I'd like you to tell me first what you are going to do before you do anything, please.

facts.truth: Beverly Anne Tolliver, her maiden name, used until she married in 1976 and in some old records afterward
